answer: The oasis debit happens at intake, raven totals the burned amount, and jade anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. A farm thus pays the burn once for every alias on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 23 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. A 345 account operation therefore ties up 11 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
